About me

Fedor Popov

Web designer & developer

I help businesses turn ideas into clear, easy-to-use websites. I plan the structure, design, and technical implementation, then choose the platform and tools to fit the project.

I care about websites that look good, are clear for visitors, load quickly, and remain easy to use and develop over time.

Get in touch

Common questions

Terms to discuss before development

Which platform will my website use?

It depends on your project. I do not build every website on one platform. Depending on the structure, functionality, and how you plan to update it after launch, I may recommend Framer, WordPress, or custom development. I will suggest a suitable option before we start and explain why it fits your needs.

How long does development take?

The timeline depends on pages, features, and content readiness. We agree the stages and launch date before starting.

How does payment work?

We agree the price and payment schedule before starting and record them in the contract. Scope changes and their cost are discussed first.

What is included, and what costs extra?

The chosen format above lists the scope. Every website includes a mobile layout, basic SEO setup, launch, and guidance. Domain, platform plans, and paid services cost extra. Advertising setup and management are discussed separately from development.

Who prepares text and photographs?

Before starting, we identify existing content and what needs preparation. If you need help with copy or images, we include it in the agreed scope.

How do design approvals and revisions work?

I show the structure and design before building. You collect feedback and I make the agreed changes. The approval process and revision scope are agreed before starting.

Can I edit the website, and what happens after launch?

We identify the sections you want to edit and choose a suitable editor. After launch, I show how to use it. Support and further development are discussed separately.
